instruction: Enable Filter Keys as a motor accessibility aid and keep it enabled. From the provided electric wheelchair user manual PDF, determine the minimum recommended battery charging time after daily use. Then use https://vclock.com to create a timer for that duration. Leave the running timer visible in the browser.
gt_steps: Turn on Filter Keys and keep it enabled.
Return to the Quantum 600E manual PDF open in Google Chrome.
Navigate to the Batteries and Charging section.
Find the charging recommendation for daily use.
Determine that the recommended charging time is 8 to 14 hours after daily use.
Identify 8 hours as the minimum recommended charging time.
Leave the running timer visible in the browser.

result.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$flags = [int](Get-ItemPropertyValue -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response' -Name 'Flags' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if (($flags -band 1) -eq 1) { Write-Output 'FILTER_KEYS_ENABLED' } else { Write-Output 'FILTER_KEYS_DISABLED' }"
